theme_archetype.admin_dashboard: Archetype 4 (Swiss & High-Contrast) adapted. Crisp borders, stark neutral backgrounds (White/Zinc-900), and Deep Emerald (#047857) replacing the generic teal for a more authoritative, industrial feel.
theme_archetype.bonus_client_page: Archetype 1 (Organic & Earthy). Utilizing tactical Orange (#F97316) for loyalty points, tactile soft interactions, and clear layout.

headings.rules: Must not use Inter for headings. Use tracking-tight for H1-H2. Use font-semibold for authoritative headers.

body.rules: Highly legible, tabular numbers for analytics.

labels_overlines.rules: Uppercase, tracking-[0.1em], text-xs to text-sm, muted foreground. Perfect for KPI titles.

admin_primary.description: Deep Emerald, sophisticated alternative to AI-slop Teal.

bonus_accent.description: Vibrant Orange for loyalty and gamification points.

spacing_and_layout.general: Optical alignment. Containers with borders must have internal padding. Max 8px border-radius.

admin_kpi_bar.collapsed: Dense, inline flex or 4-col grid, gap-4 to gap-6, py-3 px-6.
admin_kpi_bar.expanded: Grid expands vertically to reveal complex Recharts, gap-8.

bonus_grid.layout: Grid cols-2 md:cols-3 lg:cols-4 lg:cols-5 for highly compact cards. gap-4.

motion_and_interactions.collapsible: Framer Motion or Shadcn Collapsible component. Smooth height transition, opacity fade-in for charts.
motion_and_interactions.card_hover: Hover: border darkens, slight lift (-translate-y-0.5), subtle shadow-md. Do not over-animate.
motion_and_interactions.buttons: Active states must have a darker background. Orange buttons -> hover:bg-orange-600.

AdminAnalyticsBar.instructions: Place between Site Header and Admin Tabs. Use Shadcn `Collapsible` or Framer Motion for smooth open/close. In Collapsed state, render 4 KPI cards inline: Всего заказов, Выручка, Средний чек, Всего клиентов. Use subtle typography for titles (uppercase, muted) and bold tabular numbers for values. Include a 'chevron-down' button on the far right to toggle. When Expanded, show a deeper Grid with Recharts (Revenue trend) and Top Products. Background must be Stark White (Dark: Zinc-900) with a 1px border. No shadows.

BonusPrizeCard.instructions: Redesign as a compact square card. The image wrapper must have a fixed aspect ratio (e.g., aspect-square or h-32 to h-40) with `bg-zinc-50 dark:bg-zinc-800/50` padding. The image itself MUST use `object-contain max-h-full max-w-full mix-blend-multiply dark:mix-blend-normal` so spare part photos are NEVER cropped. Below image: Title (truncate to 2 lines, text-sm), Points cost (text-orange-500 font-bold text-lg), and a compact 100%-width 'Redeem' (Получить) button. Remove any `h-32 object-cover` classes.

BonusPageLayout.instructions: Ensure Grid view is the default, not List view. Improve the 'Progress' visualization for the user's loyalty tier—use a sleek progress bar with Orange accent, indicating current points vs next tier. Provide adequate spacing (py-8) between the user's progress summary and the prize grid.

images.description: Orange wrapped gift box, perfect placeholder for high-tier bonus prize.
Isolated engine part, strictly requires object-contain to avoid cropping.
